title: Core: insertFrame and removeFrame at arbitrary positions
description: Unit tests for insertFrame(doc, sceneIdx, layerIdx, frameIdx, count) and removeFrame(doc, sceneIdx, layerIdx, frameIdx, count) at non-zero frame positions. Test: inserting frames in the middle shifts subsequent keyframes, removing frames merges spans correctly, frameCount stays in sync. These functions are in packages/core/src/engine/frames.ts. Tests in packages/core/src/engine/__tests__/frame-insert-remove.test.ts.
